data.body: Landed as Gerrit change 1679, merged to main as c18069c841 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). Removed _RETIRED_GITATTRIBUTES_LINES, the strip arm, and the migration paragraph from the ensure-unit docstring; the gitattributes unit is now create-only. tests/interfaces/store/test_gitattributes_merge.py lost the C4 migration test; the drift matrix's gitattributes drift was retargeted from 'committed file carries the retired line' to 'no committed .gitattributes at all', which the surviving create arm reconverges. docs/release-notes.md carries the pre-1.0 pass #3 entry and CHANGELOG.md an Unreleased Removed bullet. Registry/tombstone treatment: NONE — this was internal store convergence, never a user-facing input, so it had no deprecation-registry row and takes no tombstone.
